body.normal: Every proposed director is identified to the Ministry of Corporate Affairs with identity and address proof and a photograph. New directors are given a Director Identification Number (DIN) through the incorporation form.
body.simple: Each director shares ID and address proof so the government can identify them.
body.detail: For each proposed director we collect identity proof (PAN for Indian nationals, passport for foreign nationals), address proof and a photograph. Documents of foreign directors usually need to be notarised or apostilled in their home country. Directors without a DIN get one through SPICe+ Part B. Every director also needs a Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) to sign the forms. After incorporation, directors confirm their KYC every year.
body.why: The incorporation form cannot be filed until every director is identified, so missing documents here hold up the whole filing.

visual.title: Proposed Directors
items: Identity proof (PAN, or passport for foreign nationals)
Existing DIN, if the director already has one
